name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck: ordering and kitchen
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep serving when the coverage disappears. The ordering app for staff in food trucks.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service from.

Customers pre-order and choose a collection time. The staff see all orders on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can make, and then mark them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN'T MAKE
Set how much the kitchen can make at once, and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can't choose it, so the queue fits the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE HATCH
Enter at-the-truck orders on the same screen as the pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to make now, what comes next, and what is ready, with an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a receipt printer in the kitchen via Bluetooth or via your local network, and the order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE COVERAGE DISAPPEARS
Switch on disconnection (offline) protection, and pre-ordering is paused if the connection drops out, so nobody can place an order you don't see. Orders you take on the device are saved and synchronised when you are connected again.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get an alert when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WEEK
Set up your events and pitches once, and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is for food truck owners and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to log in.
